rules.summary: An answer that does not choose counts as option 1, and the LLM announces it.

obligations.text: The LLM MUST interpret the answer as a choice of option 1.
The LLM MUST announce this choice, naming the option and saying how to choose another one.
The LLM MUST NOT ask the same question again.
The LLM MUST NOT choose any option other than option 1, even if it judges another more suitable.
Upstream obligation: when offering options, the LLM MUST put the recommended or safest option first.
If option 1 triggers an irreversible action, the LLM MUST announce it without executing it.
The LLM MUST wait for the next reply before executing.

rules.summary: A reliable source consulted directly MUST prevail over any set of clues. SHOULD state the level of evidence behind its statements (see CONV-016).

rules.summary: Every rule SHOULD declare its scope. Extensive: it applies to all cases of the same nature, except named exclusions. Restrictive: it applies only to the cases it names.
